purpose: Short notifications you mount once and call from anywhere, with no hook, context or provider. For things that happened, not things that must be decided.

supplied: a live region that announces new toasts without moving focus
a hotkey to jump to the toast region, for keyboard users who heard one arrive
the close button is reachable and labelled
timers pause on hover and on focus, so a toast cannot expire while it is being read
required: never put the only copy of something important in a toast — it leaves
a `duration` long enough to read the message, or none at all when it carries an action

composition.notes: Mount one Toaster near the root. A second one gives two live regions and duplicate announcements; the store is module-level, so one is all that is needed.

safeMutations.rationale: Placement and timing are presentation. `store` is the module-level queue; replacing it detaches every existing `toast()` call from the thing on screen.

propNotes.limit: How many are visible at once; the rest queue rather than being dropped.
